A rookie idol group, CRS, came to 1theK to be judged!
If they prove their singing and performance skills, 
they can make their debut performance on the stage....?!

The first gate is called singing live judgement!  
From TAEYEON’s gill part (“What Do I Call You”) one breath challenge
to the ‘singing live on a treadmill’ to prove their live singing performances!

Can CSR pass this gate of singing live judgement?
